end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere across three attempts.
Matched everyday objects to 3D shapes in two attempts.
Recognised shapes in different positions and sizes in two attempts.
The child distinguished a flat circle from a 3D sphere using a football example.
Teach-back was not passed; the child repeatedly requested a belan (rolling pin) image or drawing for cylinder.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere, matching objects to shapes, and recognising shapes in different sizes and positions. Ishita explained that a circle is flat while a football is a sphere, and identified a dice as a cube and a battery or belan as a cylinder. The main mix-up was not mathematical: the requested belan image did not appear, and this was still unresolved at the end. At home, show or draw a belan and ask Ishita to name its 3D shape.
